findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_youtube_transcript, get_transcript_languages, get_channel_latest_videos, list_channel_posts, get_channel_banner · Private data: get_youtube_transcript · Public sink: search_youtube, get_channel_latest_videos, list_channel_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_youtube_transcript, get_transcript_languages, get_channel_latest_videos, list_channel_posts, get_channel_banner · Private data: get_youtube_transcript · Public sink: search_youtube, get_channel_latest_videos, list_channel_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
